identity.title: Reconcile merged PR after a late reviewed-head advance

values.summary: Added a typed reconcile-merged publication command that observes an explicit merged PR and fails closed on final-head or identity drift.
actual_changes: Add reconcile-merged CLI request with explicit PR number
Require current clean final-head review through the existing publication guard
Validate merged state, final SHA, repository route, base, head, title, body, and draft state
Record final merged publication evidence for normal readiness and closeout

actual_validation.purpose: Prove merged-head identity rejection, unchanged draft publication behavior, and full C-SDLC v2 regression safety
